'''Ord Gustald'''<ref name="EGTW" /> was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|419|Ord}} states that the term "[[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]]" and the abbreviation "Ord" applied to certain [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].</ref> located in the [[Ord Gustald system/Legends|Ord Gustald system]]. It was situated in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Ord Gustald served as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ord Gustald was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ord Gustald [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the world itself, in grid square Q-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
